name: MQTECH
recent: MQ Technology Berhad 近期完成可赎回可转换债券转换为新股，并出现董事及大股东股权变动。公司于2026年8月27日召开常年股东大会，除第4项决议被撤回外，其余决议均获通过。最新季度（截至2026年8月31日）营收环比增长7.5%，但净亏损扩大。
notable: 可赎回可转换债券转换为新股，分别于2026年8月28日及9月10日上市，共发行7800万股。
执行董事Terence Cheah Eu Lee于2026年9月17日及18日合计增持1700万股。
2026年8月27日常年股东大会通过所有决议，惟第4项重选Dato' Masrul Affendy bin Masram的决议被撤回。
risks: 可赎回可转换债券转换为新股导致股本扩大，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
最新季度净亏损824.6万令吉，净亏损率扩大至276.9%。
大股东Triton Capital Fund VCC及Yap Siew Lynn出现股权变动（不再是大股东）。
earnings: 截至2026年8月31日季度营收297.8万令吉，环比增长7.5%，同比增长36.2%；净亏损824.6万令吉，净亏损率276.9%，较上季度的-8.1%大幅扩大。

recent_en: MQ Technology Berhad recently completed the conversion of redeemable convertible bonds into new shares, with changes in director and substantial shareholder interests. The company held its AGM on 27 August 2026, where all resolutions were passed except Resolution 4, which was withdrawn. For the latest quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue rose 7.5% QoQ but net loss widened.
notable_en: Conversion of redeemable convertible bonds into new shares, listed on 28 August and 10 September 2026, totalling 78 million shares.
Executive Director Terence Cheah Eu Lee acquired a total of 17 million shares on 17 and 18 September 2026.
All resolutions were passed at the AGM on 27 August 2026, except Resolution 4 on the re-election of Dato' Masrul Affendy bin Masram, which was withdrawn.
risks_en: Conversion of redeemable convertible bonds into new shares enlarges share capital and may dilute existing shareholders.
Latest quarter net loss was MYR 8.246 million, with net margin widening to -276.9%.
Substantial shareholder changes: Triton Capital Fund VCC and Yap Siew Lynn ceased to be substantial shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was MYR 2.978 million, up 7.5% QoQ and 36.2% YoY; net loss was MYR 8.246 million with a net margin of -276.9%, significantly wider than -8.1% in the previous quarter.
